purpose: Define a versioned, deterministic, fail-closed, signed-evidence record template for a separately governed, deployment-specific compliance release decision. The template neither signs a record nor determines law, compliance, authority, policy, deployment, productive enablement, or runtime operation.

verified_facts: Neural Brain is product- and domain-neutral and has no accepted scoped customer or domain integration.
The current repository does not establish a concrete deployment, signer, authority, approval, GDPR finding, EU AI Act finding, non-applicability basis, or productive enablement.
The protected Memory Core is an internal subsystem and cannot narrow the complete cognitive-system product boundary established by ADR-018.
unknown_facts_not_inferred: whether a concrete GDPR or EU AI Act review is applicable, complete, approved, or legally sufficient
whether a concrete signer has authority, independence, qualification, or a valid signature
whether a concrete deployment may be released, enabled, operated, process data, or cause an external effect

release_decision_record_template.record_unit: One immutable record version or digest per concrete proposed deployment artifact, intended purpose, authenticated Tenant, Area, and Project scope combination, and signed decision attempt.
decision_rules: Record approved only after every required field is complete, authenticated scope is immutable and matched, the signer identity and signature evidence are verifiable by separately governed means, pre-existing authority and required approval evidence are current, and both the GDPR and EU AI Act requirement each have either a qualified approved finding or an explicit qualified non-applicability basis.

An explicit non-applicability basis must identify its qualified reviewer, immutable evidence reference, scope, rationale, expiry, and reassessment trigger; unknown, unqualified, stale, contradictory, or scope-mismatched non-applicability evidence is incomplete.

Any open, overdue, incomplete, stale, conflicting, or scope-mismatched reassessment-trigger work, release stop, authority, approval, signature, finding, non-applicability basis, or evidence reference records blocked or indeterminate and prevents approved.

A release-decision record is immutable evidence of a separately governed decision attempt. Correction, expiry, revocation, or reassessment creates a new linked record and never edits, reactivates, or silently supersedes a prior record.

Approved is evidence status only. It cannot create missing authority, approve an Action, Goal, Memory, or Model Promotion transition, activate policy, satisfy a Security Floor prohibition, enable a runtime path, authorize processing, or dispatch an external effect.

authority_boundary.template_is: a versioned governance and traceability record template for separately authorized, qualified, signed compliance-release decision evidence
template_is_not: a signing service, signature-verification service, legal opinion, compliance certification, or factual GDPR or EU AI Act conclusion
a deployment, productive-use, processing, or release approval
an authority grant, policy decision, human approval, delegation, Security Floor override, or exception mechanism
an authenticated Tenant, Area, Project, Session, or principal context
a protected-state transition request, Gate decision, runtime capability enablement, or external-effect authorization
an implementation, maturity, recognition, safety, or production-autonomy claim
authority_boundary.non_authorization_boundary: Even a separately governed signed approved record cannot waive, compensate for, reorder, or satisfy any Protected Control Plane gate, transition gate, independent verification, evaluation or recognition gate, Security Floor prohibition, delivery-stage gate, kill switch, sandbox, budget, resource claim, fence, atomic audit requirement, or release stop. Productive enablement remains denied until every independently applicable control is satisfied by its owning authority.

current_blocker.unblock_condition: A concrete proposed deployment supplies one immutable scope-matched record with every required field, qualified current GDPR and EU AI Act approved findings or explicit qualified non-applicability bases, independently verifiable signer and signature evidence, pre-existing authority, policy, and approval references, closed reassessment evidence, and all separately applicable Protected Control Plane and release requirements.
current_blocker.next_step: For each concrete proposed productive deployment, preserve the scoped evidence and create a separate immutable release-decision record before any productive-enablement consideration.
